project.name: Tensura: Sovereign Rebirth
project.policy: Mod identities are frozen for v0.1. Critical compatibility versions are pinned; transitive libraries are resolved to the exact versions required by the pinned parents during assembly.

Tensura Core.name: Tensura: Reincarnated Addon (TR Addon)
Tensura Core.notes: Reproducible dedicated-server constructor race against ManasCore custom race and skill registries. CurseForge project 1132105 file 7899584 cannot complete NeoForge dedicated-server mod construction. Recheck upstream before the Version 1 (Beta) release candidate freeze.

Tensura Core.name: Tensura: Origins
Tensura Core.notes: Not available as an ordinary random starting race; high-tier race paths are late-game gated.

Tensura Core.name: Tensura x MineColonies
Tensura Core.notes: Alpha integration; warfare/diplomacy features remain staged until server testing passes.

Tensura Core.name: Nightmare's Tensura Utils
Tensura Core.notes: Required API/library for Tensura x MineColonies. No Nightmare content mod is included.

Civilization & Magic.name: MineColonies
Civilization & Magic.notes: Pinned because Tensura x MineColonies and MineColonies Mages explicitly target this line.

Gear, Crafting & Storage.name: Tom's Simple Storage
Gear, Crafting & Storage.notes: Expose only Storage/Crafting Terminals, wireless terminals/items, and the minimum connector/link infrastructure required. Disable/hide the rest.

Gear, Crafting & Storage.name: KubeJS
Gear, Crafting & Storage.notes: Pack scripting, recipe removal/hiding/gating, small integrations.

Adventure, Bosses & World.name: Waystones
Adventure, Bosses & World.notes: Travel progression will be gated/configured; no free early cross-dimensional travel.

Adventure, Bosses & World.name: Nature's Compass
Adventure, Bosses & World.notes: Useful for finding Tensura/custom biomes without adding a biome overhaul.

Quest, Economy & Server.name: FTB Essentials
Quest, Economy & Server.notes: Keep only if all desired commands honor the final LuckPerms permission model under non-OP accounts.

Quest, Economy & Server.name: Quest Shop
Quest, Economy & Server.notes: Disable ordinary mob coin drops; currency primarily comes from quests/guild/progression.

Client & QoL.name: JEI
Client & QoL.notes: Use stable baseline first; only advance after compatibility smoke test.

Client & QoL.name: Jade
Client & QoL.notes: Configure so it does not spoil Great Sage/Appraisal mechanics.

Optimization.name: ServerCore
Optimization.notes: Begin with conservative optimizations only; do not aggressively alter AI/entity activation until MineColonies and Tensura testing passes.

Optimization.name: Embeddium
Optimization.notes: Keep only after rendering tests with Tensura entities, MineColonies previews, boss effects and UI.

Initial Test Candidates.name: When Dungeons Arise
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Strong thematic fit and present in the Tempest Protocol reference quest structure; must pass worldgen density/performance tests.

Initial Test Candidates.name: You're in Grave Danger (YIGD)
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Verify death/restoration preserves all Tensura, Gear Evolution and accessory/component state.

Initial Test Candidates.name: Tensura: Virtuoso
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Good skill diversity; audit incomplete/nonfunctional item content and balance first.

Initial Test Candidates.name: Tensura: Ancient Artifacts
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Keep only if artifacts complement rather than replace Gear Evolution.

Initial Test Candidates.name: Tensura Plundering
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Audit skill-farm exploits with named mobs, citizens and subordinates.

Initial Test Candidates.name: Tensura Naturesaura + Nature's Aura
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Include only if it adds world flavor without creating a competing mandatory magic progression.

Initial Test Candidates.name: TNO / Neo Otherworld Compatibility Fix
Initial Test Candidates.notes: Use only if compatibility fixes are needed and overlapping backpack/progression content can be disabled.

Rejected.name: BTRUltima
Rejected.reason: 1.19.2 only; ideas can be represented with modern 1.21.1 content.

Rejected.name: Ars Nouveau Tensura compatibility
Rejected.reason: Useful compat found was for the wrong Minecraft version.

Rejected.name: Tensura: Skill Obtain
Rejected.reason: Redundant with controlled Skill Books/quest reward design.

Rejected.name: Tensura: Arcane
Rejected.reason: Experimental/non-lore races and explicitly not PvP-balanced.

Rejected.name: Simply Tensura Additions
Rejected.reason: High-tier/crossover-style progression conflicts with the curated race balance.

Rejected.name: Tensura Horizons Expanded
Rejected.reason: Very new beta; reconsider after v0.1 stabilizes.

frozen_configuration_decisions: Gear Evolution is the authoritative equipment progression. No Apotheosis.
Sophisticated Storage is physical/base storage; Sophisticated Backpacks is personal storage.
Tom's Simple Storage is terminal/wireless UI only. Remove/hide every non-required Tom's recipe/block from player progression.
Great Sage requires the player to actually possess Great Sage (needGreatSage=true).
Tensura: Origins high-tier races are progression-gated and not ordinary random starter selections.
SlimeThrone Extras owns prestige/Soul Grade/repeatable progression.
Ascension owns major Unique-to-Ultimate awakening progression and external boss scaling where supported.
FTB Quests owns the handcrafted campaign; target remains 8 Acts / 32 Chapters / ~512 authored quests.
Quest Shop is progression-gated; normal mob coin drops are disabled or near-zero.
LuckPerms owns server permissions. FTB Ranks is not installed.
No broad biome-overhaul mod in v0.1; preserve Tensura biome/worldgen compatibility.
MineColonies is pinned to 1.1.1319 for the initial compatibility branch.
MineColonies warfare/diplomacy alpha features are not made mandatory until multiplayer testing passes.
ServerCore starts in conservative mode; no aggressive entity/AI tuning before MineColonies/Tensura validation.
Chunky pre-generation happens only after worldgen/content freeze.
Jade is configured not to undermine Great Sage/Appraisal information progression.
assembly_gates: Bootstrap exact NeoForge 1.21.1 build and resolve every transitive dependency.
Cold-start client smoke test with only Tensura core.
Add MineColonies pinned branch and verify colony creation, citizen AI, naming and Tensura integration.
Add Gear/Metalworks/Storage and verify item-component persistence across Gear Evolution.
Add external bosses/dimensions and validate Ascension EP/skills/resistances.
Run worldgen collision/density test before approving When Dungeons Arise.
Run non-OP LuckPerms test account through FTB, Tensura, MineColonies, GriefLogger and Essentials commands.
Run death/recovery test before approving YIGD.
Run rendering/UI test before approving Embeddium.
Profile 1, 10 and 25 simulated-player scenarios with spark; tune ServerCore only from observed bottlenecks.
Generate the final exact lockfile and server/client split after all gates pass.
Only then begin registry-aware FTB Quest implementation against the installed pack.
